title: PickMe candidate catalogue
description: Documents the shape of candidate-catalogue.json exactly as decoded by Engine/Sources/CardCopilotEngine/Models/CatalogueModels.swift's CandidateSet (see SeedLoader.loadCandidateCatalogue). Since 2.0 this file names which card-catalogue.json products are researched acquisition candidates by id; it does not redefine them (a card defined in two places drifts — see candidate-catalogue.json's own _provenance note). `_provenance` is documentation-only: CandidateSet decodes only candidateCatalogueVersion and cardIds, so a free-text `_` key is present in the JSON but silently dropped on load, same convention as card-catalogue.schema.json's own `_provenance`.

^_.description: Free-text annotation (e.g. _provenance). Not decoded by the engine.

candidateCatalogueVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR. Load-bearing: SeedLoader.validate(candidateCatalogueVersion:) parses MAJOR and throws SeedLoaderError.unsupportedCatalogueVersion if it isn't supportedCandidateCatalogueMajorVersion (currently 2, the bump when this file became a list of cardIds instead of full card definitions).

cardIds.description: Ids of products in card-catalogue.json that are acquisition candidates. Referential integrity against card-catalogue.json's own cardId values is not expressed here — JSON Schema validates shape, not cross-file references; AcquisitionAnalyzerTests covers that a listed id actually resolves.
